title: Investigation Allowance Credited With Premier and Elite Final Claim Credits, Paystride Visa Payroll Card
content:
The investigation allowance credited with a final credit on the Paystride Visa Payroll Card Premier or Elite plan follows the time from the claim's notice date to its resolution date.

| Kind of transaction | 25.00 when the time is more than | 10.00 when not, but more than |
|---|---|---|
| new-account transaction | 90 calendar days | 20 business days |
| point-of-sale or foreign-initiated, not new-account | 90 calendar days | 10 business days |
| any other transaction | 45 calendar days | 10 business days |

When neither applies, the allowance is nothing.

**Terms used.**
- A new-account transaction is one that posted no more than 30 calendar days after the account's first deposit date.
- A point-of-sale transaction is a purchase.
- A foreign-initiated transaction is one marked as a foreign transaction.
- Business days are Monday through Friday excluding Federal Reserve holidays, counted from the day after the earlier date through the later one.

*Hypothetical:* a domestic ATM withdrawal, not new-account, resolved 50 calendar days after the notice earns 25.00. A purchase resolved after the same 50 days earns 10.00, since its calendar limit is 90 and it ran past 10 business days.
